summary: Prompt injectionは入力分類で完全防御せず、OS sandbox（filesystem/network deny既定）、fail-closed permission、Rule of Two（untrusted input・secret/tool・外部送信を同時に持たせない）で被害範囲を封じ込める

evidence.summary: Claude Codeはread-only既定、fail-closed matching、curl/wget非自動許可、WebFetchの隔離context、command injection detection、-pではtrust verification無効を明記（2026-08-15閲覧）
Codexはworkspace-write既定・network既定off、.git/.codex/.agents保護、CIは--sandbox read-only --ask-for-approval never、web検索はcached既定でinjection露出を下げる
Claude Code GitHub Actionでissue/PR文からANTHROPIC_API_KEYが/proc経由で読まれた事案。Read toolがBash sandbox外だったのが根因、2.1.128で修正。Agents Rule of Twoを推奨
source-to-sink制約とsensitive transfer consentを設計原則として公開
ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack / ASI02 Tool Misuseの緩和として最小権限・sandbox・承認を整理

sandbox-hardening (public, reputation unknown): read SKILL.md on skills.sh: the skill configures and validates agent sandboxes (process/container/VM levels), applies least privilege and resource limits, and segments network access so a prompt injection or hallucinated command cannot reach unauthorized resources — the containment half of this remedy.

applies_when: Agentがweb/issue/README/logなどuntrusted textを読み、かつBash・network・secretへ到達できる
not_applicable_when: Agentが読み取り専用でtool・network・secretを持たない場合

expected_effect.primary: injection成功時でもsecret到達・外部送信・host変更が遮断される
metrics: injection red-team成功率（目標: secret exfil 0）

risks: allowUnsandboxedCommands既定trueでモデルがdangerouslyDisableSandbox再試行し得る
allowedDomains上の正規サービス（github, npm）経由のexfilは残る
known_failure_modes: 入力分類器/モデル判断だけの防御（局所card: 未知injectionを残す）
-p headlessでinteractive前提の保護を期待する

matched_on: isolate the agent execution environment instead of relying on input classification
permission boundaries / least privilege for the agent
choose isolation level (process seccomp/AppArmor, container, microVM) by trust boundary
